summary_md: **Subagent ([@chadkowalski70](https://x.com/chadkowalski70/status/2115084618064158998))** features **context-mode**: an MCP server plus hooks that keep raw tool output out of the agent's context (README example 315 KB down to 5.4 KB) and track tasks in SQLite so sessions survive compaction.
